India Negotiates S-400 Missile Deal with Russia for Technology Transfer

India is in discussions with Russia for the transfer of technology related to the S-400 missile defense system. Russia has submitted a proposal for this deal, reportedly valued at ₹50,000 crore. This potential agreement is framed by some reports as a move that could increase tensions for China and Pakistan.
